# Target mc-26.4 — changes and facts

Minecraft Java 26.4, pinned to the snapshot `26.4-snapshot-7` (2026-11-03) until the release lands (ADR 0037 D1; the re-pin is reserve brief B163). `channel: 'snapshot'`: offered in the app with a badge, never the default for new projects.

Checked on 2026-11-05.

## Vendored data

- `vendor/vanilla-mcdoc/symbols.json`: Spyglass symbol export, regenerated by `tools/sync-mcdoc`.
- `vendor/mcmeta/`: `version.json`, `registries.json`, `commands.json`, `blocks.json`, regenerated by `tools/sync-mcmeta`. Registry ids are stored without the `minecraft:` namespace.

## What changed from 26.3

- Registries (190 → 192): `rule_test` became `rule_test_type` with the same members; `block_sound_set` and `tag/block_sound_set` are new.
- Removed members (`src/removed-ids.ts`, tied to the diff of both vendored files by `test/removed-ids.test.ts`): `fluid` `flowing_water`, `flowing_lava`; `worldgen/feature_type` `large_dripstone` (the configured and placed features of that name remain); `worldgen/density_function_type` `interpolated`; `particle_type` `item_snowball`; `model` `block/cube_top`; `sound_event` `intentionally_empty`; `tag/entity_type` `freeze_immune_entity_types`, `ignores_poison_and_regen`; eight GUI sprite textures. `migrateFrom` reports each as `target.removed-id`.
- Known rename: feature type `large_dripstone` → `large_speleothem`, whose config gained the required `base_block`, so the migration reports it with a hint instead of rewriting it.
- Data formats: noise settings lost `default_block` (`until 26.4` in the vendored mcdoc), so the 26.3-shaped default data of `minecraft:worldgen/noise_settings` reports one unknown field on this target. `LargeSpeleothemConfig.base_block` is new. Everything else is additions (25 blocks, 28 items, biome `ice_caves`, entities `frostbite` and `ice_ball`, effect `freezing`).
| Wolf sound variant out again (ADR 0106 amendment, 2026-11-22) | `minecraft:wolf_sound_variant` is not offered: the vendored vanilla-mcdoc has no `step_sound`, which the game requires; the `folders.data` key stays (plugin API 1.9.0) |
